summary: Energy Fuels Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire VAC Group B.V. and related entities through a series of mergers. The aggregate purchase price consists of $718,000,000 in cash and stock (consideration type not fully detailed). The transaction involves multiple merger subs and step mergers across Dutch, US, and Canadian entities. The board of Energy Fuels approved the agreement; no advisor named. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory review timeline; risk-arb spread hinges on completion certainty and financing details.
